# Register map

All registers are 16 bits wide and are reached through the host SPI port at an 8-bit address. See [architecture.md](architecture.md) for the SPI framing.

Access types: RO read only, RW read/write, W1C write 1 to clear, WO write only.

| Address range | Contents |
|---|---|
| `0x00`–`0x1F` | Global registers |
| `0x20`–`0x2F` | Engine SM0 registers |
| `0x30`–`0x3F` | Engine SM1 registers |
| `0x40`–`0x4F` | Engine SM2 registers |
| `0x50`–`0x5F` | Engine SM3 registers |
| `0x80`–`0xBF` | Instruction memory, 64 words (read/write) |

Unlisted addresses read 0 and ignore writes.

## Global registers

| Address | Name | Access | Bits | Field | Reset | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `0x00` | `ID` | RO | 15:0 | `ID` | 0xB717 | Chip identifier. Reads 0xB717. |
| `0x01` | `VERSION` | RO | 15:0 | `VERSION` | 0x100 | Design version. Major in the high byte, minor in the low byte. |
| `0x02` | `CTRL` | RW | 3:0 | `EN` | 0 | **Engine enables and restart strobes.** Engine enable, one bit per engine. All engines enabled by one write start on the same clock cycle. |
| | | | 7:4 | `RESTART` | 0 | Write 1 to restart an engine: clears its scratch and shift registers, counters, delay, BAU state and clock-divider phase, and sets PC to ORG. Reads 0. |
| `0x03` | `INT_STAT` | RO | 7:0 | `IRQ` | 0 | **Interrupt sources. HOST_IRQ is high while (INT_STAT & INT_EN) != 0.** The eight IRQ flags. |
| | | | 11:8 | `RXNE` | 0 | RX FIFO not empty, one bit per engine. |
| | | | 15:12 | `TXNF` | 0 | TX FIFO not full, one bit per engine. |
| `0x04` | `INT_EN` | RW | 15:0 | `EN` | 0 | Interrupt enable mask, same layout as INT_STAT. 1 = the source drives HOST_IRQ. |
| `0x05` | `IRQ` | W1C | 7:0 | `FLAGS` | 0 | IRQ flags shared by the engines. Read the flags; write 1 to clear a flag. |
| `0x06` | `IRQ_FORCE` | WO | 7:0 | `FLAGS` | 0 | Set IRQ flags from the host. Write 1 to set a flag. Reads 0. |
| `0x07` | `FSTAT` | RO | 3:0 | `TXFULL` | 0 | **FIFO status, one bit per engine in each field.** TX FIFO full. |
| | | | 7:4 | `TXEMPTY` | 0 | TX FIFO empty. |
| | | | 11:8 | `RXFULL` | 0 | RX FIFO full. |
| | | | 15:12 | `RXEMPTY` | 0 | RX FIFO empty. |
| `0x08` | `FDEBUG` | W1C | 3:0 | `TXOVER` | 0 | **Sticky FIFO error flags, one bit per engine in each field.** The host pushed to a full TX FIFO; the word was dropped. |
| | | | 7:4 | `RXUNDER` | 0 | The host read an empty RX FIFO; it read 0. |
| | | | 11:8 | `TXSTALL` | 0 | The engine stalled on (or a non-blocking PULL found) an empty TX FIFO. |
| | | | 15:12 | `RXSTALL` | 0 | The engine stalled on (or a non-blocking PUSH dropped data at) a full RX FIFO. |
| `0x09` | `TS_PRESCALE` | RW | 7:0 | `DIV` | 0 | Timestamp prescaler. The timestamp counter advances every DIV+1 clock cycles. |
| `0x0A` | `TIME` | RW | 15:0 | `TIME` | 0 | Free-running 16-bit timestamp counter. Read the counter; write to set it (also clears the prescaler phase). |
| `0x10` | `PIN_IN_LO` | RO | 15:0 | `PINS` | 0 | Pin inputs after the synchronizer and glitch filter. Input level for PIN15..PIN0, one bit per pin |
| `0x11` | `PIN_IN_HI` | RO | 2:0 | `PINS` | 0 | Pin inputs, upper pins. Input level for PIN18..PIN16 |
| `0x12` | `PIN_OUT_LO` | RW | 15:0 | `PINS` | 0 | Pin output register. Engines writing a pin in the same cycle win. Bits for PIN0..PIN4 read 0. Output level for PIN15..PIN0, one bit per pin |
| `0x13` | `PIN_OUT_HI` | RW | 2:0 | `PINS` | 0 | Pin output register, upper pins. Output level for PIN18..PIN16 |
| `0x14` | `PIN_OE_LO` | RW | 15:0 | `PINS` | 0 | Pin output enable (direction) register. Bits for PIN0..PIN4 read 0. 1 = output for PIN15..PIN0, one bit per pin |
| `0x15` | `PIN_OE_HI` | RW | 2:0 | `PINS` | 0 | Pin output enable register, upper pins. 1 = output for PIN18..PIN16 |
| `0x16` | `PAD_OD_LO` | RW | 15:0 | `PINS` | 0 | Open-drain mode. Implemented for PIN11..PIN18 only; other bits read 0. 1 = open drain (drive low or float, never drive high) for PIN15..PIN0, one bit per pin |
| `0x17` | `PAD_OD_HI` | RW | 2:0 | `PINS` | 0 | Open-drain mode, upper pins. 1 = open drain for PIN18..PIN16 |
| `0x18` | `PAD_FILT_LO` | RW | 15:0 | `PINS` | 0 | Input glitch filter. Implemented for PIN0..PIN4 and PIN11..PIN18. 1 = input must hold for 3 clock cycles before it is seen for PIN15..PIN0, one bit per pin |
| `0x19` | `PAD_FILT_HI` | RW | 2:0 | `PINS` | 0 | Input glitch filter, upper pins. 1 = filter on for PIN18..PIN16 |

## Per-engine registers

Engine *n* has its registers at `0x20 + 0x10 * n + offset`.

| Address | Name | Access | Bits | Field | Reset | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `+0x0` | `CLKDIV_INT` | RW | 15:0 | `INT` | 1 | Clock divider, integer part. Clock cycles per engine tick (0 means 65536). |
| `+0x1` | `CLKDIV_FRAC` | RW | 7:0 | `FRAC` | 0 | Clock divider, fractional part. Extra 1/256ths of a clock cycle per tick. |
| `+0x2` | `WRAP` | RW | 5:0 | `BOTTOM` | 0 | **Program wrap addresses (absolute instruction-memory addresses).** Address executed after the instruction at TOP. |
| | | | 13:8 | `TOP` | 0x3F | Last address of the wrap range. |
| `+0x3` | `ORG` | RW | 5:0 | `ORG` | 0 | **Program origin and jump pin.** Instruction-memory address of the program's first instruction. Jump targets are relative to it. |
| | | | 12:8 | `JMP_PIN` | 0 | Pin tested by JMP PIN (0..31, including the virtual pins). |
| `+0x4` | `PINCTRL0` | RW | 4:0 | `IN_BASE` | 0 | **Pin bases.** First pin read by IN PINS, MOV x, PINS and WAIT PIN. |
| | | | 9:5 | `OUT_BASE` | 0 | First pin written by OUT PINS, OUT PINDIRS and MOV PINS. |
| | | | 14:10 | `SET_BASE` | 0 | First pin written by SET PINS and SET PINDIRS. |
| `+0x5` | `PINCTRL1` | RW | 4:0 | `SIDE_BASE` | 0 | **Side-set base and pin counts.** First side-set pin. |
| | | | 9:5 | `OUT_COUNT` | 0 | Number of pins written by OUT and MOV (0..16). |
| | | | 12:10 | `SET_COUNT` | 0 | Number of pins written by SET (0..5). |
| | | | 14:13 | `SIDE_COUNT` | 0 | Number of side-set data bits (0..3). |
| | | | 15 | `SIDE_EN` | 0 | 1 = the top bit of the delay/side-set field is a per-instruction side-set enable. |
| `+0x6` | `SHIFTCTRL` | RW | 3:0 | `PUSH_THRESH` | 0 | **Shift register control.** ISR bit count that triggers autopush and PUSH IFFULL (0 means 16). |
| | | | 7:4 | `PULL_THRESH` | 0 | OSR bit count that triggers autopull, PULL IFEMPTY and !OSRE (0 means 16). |
| | | | 8 | `AUTOPUSH` | 0 | 1 = push the ISR automatically when it reaches PUSH_THRESH. |
| | | | 9 | `AUTOPULL` | 0 | 1 = refill the OSR automatically when it reaches PULL_THRESH. |
| | | | 10 | `IN_SHIFTDIR` | 1 | ISR shift direction: 1 = right (new bits enter at bit 15), 0 = left. |
| | | | 11 | `OUT_SHIFTDIR` | 1 | OSR shift direction: 1 = right (bit 0 leaves first), 0 = left. |
| | | | 12 | `SIDE_PINDIR` | 0 | 1 = side-set drives pin directions instead of pin levels. |
| `+0x7` | `FIFOCTRL` | RW | 0 | `JOIN_TX` | 0 | **FIFO configuration. Any write clears both FIFOs of this engine.** 1 = TX FIFO is 8 deep, RX FIFO disabled. |
| | | | 1 | `JOIN_RX` | 0 | 1 = RX FIFO is 8 deep, TX FIFO disabled (ignored if JOIN_TX is set). |
| | | | 2 | `CHAIN_EN` | 0 | 1 = this engine's TX FIFO is fed from another engine's RX FIFO. |
| | | | 4:3 | `CHAIN_SRC` | 0 | Engine whose RX FIFO feeds this TX FIFO. |
| `+0x8` | `TMO` | RW | 15:0 | `TICKS` | 0 | WAIT timeout. A timed WAIT gives up after TICKS+1 failed checks. |
| `+0x9` | `BAU_POLY` | RW | 15:0 | `POLY` | 0 | BAU CRC polynomial. Reflected (right-shifting) polynomial; the width is implied by its top set bit. |
| `+0xA` | `BAU_CFG` | RW | 2:0 | `STUFF_N` | 0 | **BAU bit-stuffing configuration.** A stuff bit follows every run of STUFF_N equal bits (0 disables). |
| | | | 3 | `STUFF_ANY` | 0 | 1 = runs of zeros and ones both count (CAN); 0 = only runs of ones (USB). |
| `+0xB` | `FIFO` | RW | 15:0 | `DATA` | 0 | FIFO access. Write: push to the TX FIFO. Read: pop from the RX FIFO (0 if empty). |
| `+0xC` | `EXEC` | RW | 15:0 | `INSTR` | 0 | Immediate execution. Write: execute this instruction on the next clock cycle, even if the engine is disabled. Read: the instruction register. |
| `+0xD` | `STAT` | RO | 5:0 | `PC` | 0 | **Engine status.** Program counter (absolute). |
| | | | 6 | `EXEC_PENDING` | 0 | An injected instruction has not completed yet. |
| | | | 11:8 | `TXLEVEL` | 0 | Words in the TX FIFO. |
| | | | 15:12 | `RXLEVEL` | 0 | Words in the RX FIFO. |

## Pin numbering

| Pins | Pads | Direction |
|---|---|---|
| PIN0..PIN4 | `ui_in[0]`..`ui_in[4]` | input only |
| PIN5..PIN10 | `uo_out[0]`..`uo_out[5]` | output only; reads back the driven level |
| PIN11..PIN18 | `uio[0]`..`uio[7]` | bidirectional, optional open drain |
| 19 | virtual | this engine's TX FIFO is empty |
| 20 | virtual | this engine's RX FIFO is full |
| 21 | virtual | BAU: the next bit is a stuff bit |
| 22 | virtual | BAU: stuff error (sticky until the BAU is reset) |
| 23 | virtual | always 0 |
| 24..31 | virtual | IRQ flags 0..7 |
